measurement_correction: The preceding component-allocation attempt was rejected because each sample re-looked up ManagementFactory's ThreadMXBean, and that post-phase lookup was charged to the measured phase. This control caches the MXBean once. Component values do not sum to aggregate_collector_join because the aggregate also includes batch construction and loop bookkeeping; batch_freeze is separately measured after the aggregate join boundary.
decision: The allocation breakdown is trustworthy enough to direct future work at owned ring-event conversion, resolved-evidence construction, and the live ring boundary. It does not prove any workload-latency improvement: both paired append-target intervals include zero.
